name: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic
hours: Mon, Tue, Thu 9 to 7. Wed and Fri 9 to 5.
description: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic is a full-service, state-of-the-art veterinary clinic and surgical facility in Northeast Philadelphia, run as a non-profit general practice for dogs and cats.

offerings.heading: What the clinic <mark>does.</mark>
items: General procedures, from wellness visits to sick-pet exams
Surgical procedures in the on-site facility
Pet dentistry and boarding in the clinic's own kennel
Non-profit general practice for all dogs and cats
Full-service, state-of-the-art clinic and surgical facility

gallery.heading: Inside the clinic, <mark>one visit at a time.</mark>

story.heading: Caring and knowledgeable, on purpose
paragraphs: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic is a full-service clinic and surgical facility in Northeast Philadelphia, with staff committed to the health and well-being of the animals in their care.
Running as a non-profit changes the math: the clinic exists to treat dogs and cats well, and a phone call is still the fastest way in.

experience.heading: How a visit works
items: Call to make an appointment; the clinic books by phone.
Bring your dog or cat to Dutton Road, with parking at the building.
Surgery, dentistry, and boarding stay in-house with the same team.

feature.heading: Surgery without a second address
feature.text: The surgical facility is part of the clinic, so the diagnosis, the procedure, and the recheck happen with people who already know your pet.

closing.heading: Call to make an appointment today
